A copy of its valid ASME AIA Certificate of Accreditation, including i ts scope (covering applicable ASME Boiler and pressure vessel code sections), limitations and validity statu s. c) The bidder shall have appropriately qualified and authorized Authorized Inspectors (AI) and Authorized I nspector Supervisors (AIS), as applicable, in accordance with ASME QAI-1–2025 and shall submit details of its proposed AI/AIS personnel, including their qualifications, experience, applicable authorizations and Nati onal Board commission details, as applicable. d) The bidder shall have a minimum of five years of experience in providing ASME Authorized Inspection se rvices. e) The bidder shall demonstrate experience in inspection of pressure vessels, boilers or other equipment manufactured under the applicable ASME Code Sections. The bidder shall demonstrate technical compete ncy in material verification, welding surveillance, NDE, heat treatment, dimensional inspection, pressure te sting and final inspection, as applicable. The bidder shall possess adequate infrastructure, technical resour ces and qualified manpower to undertake inspection activities at the manufacturer's premises. f) The bidder shall submit details of previous ASME inspection assignments, including client details, work o rders and satisfactory performance/completion certificates. g) Tenderer should enclose PAN, GSTIN registration no., Income tax returns for last three years (AY- 2023- 24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 / 2026-27) .
